choice_prompt:13:1410833409.source_cn: 我没有什么钱……我的存款全都拿去搞研究了。但我可以给你干活！你不需要付我一分钱！
choice_prompt:13:1410833409.male: I don't have much money on me... All my savings are tied up in research. But I can work for you for free! I'll do anything!
choice_prompt:13:1410833409.female: I don't have much money on me... All my savings are tied up in research. But I can work for you for free! I'll do anything!

say:14:1410833411:1.text: The fate of the Eclipsion is in your hands!
say:14:1410833411:1.male: The fate of the Eclipsion is in your hands!
say:14:1410833411:1.female: The fate of the Eclipsion is in your hands!

choice:11:0:1.text: How much are you willing to pay?
choice:11:0:1.male: How much are you willing to pay?
choice:11:0:1.female: How much are you willing to pay?

say:16:1410833410:1.text: Thank you! From now on, I'll do whatever you ask of me!
say:16:1410833410:1.source_cn: 谢谢你！从此以后，无论你使唤我做什么都行！
say:16:1410833410:1.male: Thank you! From now on, I'll do whatever you ask of me!
say:16:1410833410:1.female: Thank you! From now on, I'll do whatever you ask of me!

choice_prompt:17:1410833410.text: Thank you! From now on, I'll do whatever you ask of me!
choice_prompt:17:1410833410.source_cn: 谢谢你！从此以后，无论你使唤我做什么都行！
choice_prompt:17:1410833410.male: Thank you! From now on, I'll do whatever you ask of me!
choice_prompt:17:1410833410.female: Thank you! From now on, I'll do whatever you ask of me!

choice:17:0:1.text: Similar words have been said before...
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 类似的话之前好像说过……
choice:17:0:1.male: Similar words have been said before...
choice:17:0:1.female: Similar words have been said before...

choice:11:1:2.text: Of course, I'd love to help.
choice:11:1:2.male: Of course, I'd love to help.
choice:11:1:2.female: Of course, I'd love to help.

say:2:1410834001:1.text: It's beautiful... A mythical relic created by Helthor himself!
say:2:1410834001:1.source_cn: 太漂亮了……这就是赫托亲手所铸的传奇！

say:3:1410834002:1.text: The gears rotate and chase enemies for thousands of miles. It always finds its target. The legendary <style="highlight">Eclipsion</style>!
say:3:1410834002:1.source_cn: 齿轮交错运转，万里逐敌，开弓必中！伟大而闪耀的<sty...

say:5:1410834004:0.text: Do you mean the roar the Eclipsion just let out? Yeah!
say:5:1410834004:0.source_cn: 你是指杜恩加尔刚才的震鸣声吗？

say:6:1410834005:0.text: As expected of a weapon forged by a god... It has its own soul. Ah, I wish I had the skills to match...
say:6:1410834005:0.source_cn: 不愧是神的造物……它拥有自己的灵魂！唉……这就是我无法...

say:7:1410834006:1.text: No, not that. Do you hear something right now...?
say:7:1410834006:1.source_cn: 不，和刚才的声音不一样。

say:10:1410834008:1.text: It's so loud I can hear it over both of your voices...
say:10:1410834008:1.source_cn: 它并不是在喃喃低语，它的声音很洪亮。你们听不到吗？

say:12:1410834011:1.text: It's calling my name. <style="highlight">It's telling me to pick it up.</style>

choice_prompt:13:1410834011.text: It's calling my name. <style="highlight">It's telling me to pick it up.</style>
choice_prompt:13:1410834011.source_cn: 它在呼唤我的名字，<style=highlight>命令我拿起它</style>。

say:14:1410834012:1.text: Yes, it's a deep, powerful voice.

say:15:1410834014:1.text: Oh... it could be Helthor's voice!
say:15:1410834014:1.source_cn: 我猜……是赫托老爹的声音。

say:16:1410834015:1.text: But why...? The Eclipsion is a relic of the dwarves!
say:16:1410834015:1.source_cn: 啊啊啊……为什么！赫托老爷子，杜恩加尔可是我们矮人一族...

say:17:1410834016:1.text: But... if that's what Helthor really wants...
say:17:1410834016:1.source_cn: 但是……但是……如果这是赫托的意愿……好吧！

say:18:1410834017:1.text: Okay! Indris, pick up the Eclipsion!
say:18:1410834017:1.source_cn: 快！因度厄，去拿起杜恩加尔！

say:20:1410834019:1.text: You listen to me! The Eclipsion is the light that shoots through the darkness!
say:20:1410834019:1.source_cn: 你给我听好！杜恩加尔不是用来供奉的圣物，而是用来射穿黑...

say:21:1410834020:1.text: As a legendary weapon, it deserves a great warrior as its partner.
say:21:1410834020:1.source_cn: 作为一把武器，它值得被优秀的战士好好使用。

say:22:1410834021:1.text: We dwarves are magical outcasts, disqualified from using this divine bow. Otherwise, I would certainly never hand it to you...
say:22:1410834021:1.source_cn: 我们是魔法的弃民，已经失去使用神弓的资格了，否则我肯定...

say:23:1410834022:1.text: Stop dawdling! Take it before I regret it! And never let it down!
say:23:1410834022:1.source_cn: 别磨蹭了，在我后悔前把它拿走！千万……千万不要辜负它！

say:24:1410834023:1.text: I understand. I won't disappoint you.

say:26:1410834013:1.source_cn: 我认为那是男性的声音。

choice:9:0:1.text: I can't hear anything when you're talking.
choice:9:0:1.male: I can't hear anything when you're talking.
choice:9:0:1.female: I can't hear anything when you're talking.

say:27:1410834009:1.text: Am I the only one who hears it...?

say:0:1410835001:0.text: Let us go awaken the Primordial Dragon!

say:1:1410841001:0.text: The Primordial Dragon is as big as a mountain.
say:1:1410841001:0.source_cn: 初始之龙的身躯如山峦般巨大。

say:2:1410841002:0.text: If such a large creature would rise and fly into the air, what a sight that would be.
say:2:1410841002:0.source_cn: 这样的庞然巨物一旦舒展身躯，腾空而起，那该是多么震撼的景象。

say:3:1410841003:0.text: How could something so big fly in the air? It's completely against the laws of aerodynamics...
say:3:1410841003:0.source_cn: 这么大，到底要怎么飞起来呢……根本不符合空气动力学——

choice_prompt:4:1410841003.text: How could something so big fly in the air? It's completely against the laws of aerodynamics...
choice_prompt:4:1410841003.source_cn: 这么大，到底要怎么飞起来呢……根本不符合空气动力学——

say:5:1410841004:0.text: Argh! I'm so tired of you magical people going against the natural order! One of these days...
say:5:1410841004:0.source_cn: 哼，真烦你们这些有了魔法就不讲常理的家伙！早晚有一天……
say:5:1410841004:0.male: Argh! I'm so tired of you magical people going against the natural order! One of these days...
say:5:1410841004:0.female: Argh! I'm so tired of you magical people going against the natural order! One of these days...

say:6:1410841005:0.text: *Sigh* Never mind! Do you have a plan for the dragon?
say:6:1410841005:0.source_cn: 先不提这个！你们有什么对付龙的方案吗？

say:7:1410841006:0.text: Once this dragon wakes up, even a tiny yawn could set off a chain reaction of calamity.
say:7:1410841006:0.source_cn: 这头龙一旦醒过来，光是打个哈欠都能引发天灾。

choice_prompt:8:1410841006.text: Once this dragon wakes up, even a tiny yawn could set off a chain reaction of calamity.
choice_prompt:8:1410841006.source_cn: 这头龙一旦醒过来，光是打个哈欠都能引发天灾。

say:9:1410841007:0.text: Are you serious? You've seen it before. It doesn't even leave a scratch.
say:9:1410841007:0.source_cn: 认真的吗？你们也看到过，它只能听个响！

say:10:1410841008:0.text: That's just for the sleeping dragon, but once it wakes...
say:10:1410841008:0.source_cn: 那只是对付沉睡的龙，如果龙醒了的话……

say:11:1410841009:0.text: Ohhh! I see what you mean. You're right; I shouldn't lose hope so soon.
say:11:1410841009:0.source_cn: 好吧好吧！我也该对自己有点信心！

say:12:1410841015:0.text: At least we have the bare bones of a plan now.
say:12:1410841015:0.source_cn: 这么看来，还是有点准备嘛！

say:13:1410841016:0.text: So, do dragons have any weaknesses?
say:13:1410841016:0.source_cn: 那么龙呢？龙有什么弱点吗？

choice_prompt:14:1410841016.text: So, do dragons have any weaknesses?
choice_prompt:14:1410841016.source_cn: 那么龙呢？龙有什么弱点吗？

say:15:1410841017:0.text: We'd already be burnt to a crisp by the time we meet its eyes!
say:15:1410841017:0.source_cn: ……等看到眼睛的时候，我们就已经被烧焦了！

say:16:1410841018:0.text: Is that really a weakness? It makes one move, and the whole place may cave in!
say:16:1410841018:0.source_cn: 这真的是弱点吗？她随便动一下我们都得躲半天！

say:17:1410841019:0.text: I think what Merlin meant was that its movements would be limited.
say:17:1410841019:0.source_cn: 我想，梅林的意思是龙的体型也会限制她的行动。
say:17:1410841019:0.male: I think what Merlin meant was that its movements would be limited.
say:17:1410841019:0.female: I think what Merlin meant was that its movements would be limited.

say:18:1410841020:0.source_cn: 尤其是在这种特殊的空间里。

say:19:1410841021:0.text: Of course, we're ants to that thing!
say:19:1410841021:0.source_cn: 确实，那家伙肯定对我们这些小生物看不上眼。

say:20:1410841022:0.text: The moment she underestimates us is our chance to strike.
say:20:1410841022:0.source_cn: 她轻敌之际，就是我们的机会。

say:22:1410841024:0.text: Legend has it that dragons have a scaly patch of reverse scales near their throat area.
say:22:1410841024:0.source_cn: 传说中巨龙的头部以下咽喉处有一块逆生长的鳞片——

say:23:1410841025:0.text: It's a dragon's only weak point.

say:24:1410841026:0.text: If she won't listen to us, we'll just aim there.
say:24:1410841026:0.source_cn: 万一……她根本不愿意听我们的辩解。就瞄准那里吧！

say:25:1410841027:0.source_cn: 嗯，我想，我已经准备好了。

say:26:1410841028:0.text: Along this path, I've wanted the truth to atone for my mistakes, to find a chance to change everything...
say:26:1410841028:0.source_cn: 这一路走来，我想要知道真相，想要赎罪，想要寻找契机改变...

say:27:1410841029:0.text: But at the end of the day, I just want to show people that there is another possibility; that we Essail have the power to make another choice.
say:27:1410841029:0.source_cn: 但最终，我只想为众人展现另一种可能性，让艾塞勒们拥有做...

say:28:1410841030:0.text: The Primordial Dragon is no exception. She deserves to know the truth and make her own choice.
say:28:1410841030:0.source_cn: 初始之龙也不例外。她应该知晓真相，做出自己的选择。

say:29:1410841031:0.text: An indiscriminate attitude toward all, with an unwavering persistence toward a goal...
say:29:1410841031:0.source_cn: 对一切事物都绝无分别的态度。对目标毫无动摇的执着……

say:30:1410841032:0.text: A determination as strong as a mountain, with a will as hot as a blazing inferno...
say:30:1410841032:0.source_cn: 这份如山岩般坚定的决心，如烈火般灼热的意志……

say:31:1410841033:0.text: Indris, take up the Eclipsion, and don't let us down!
say:31:1410841033:0.source_cn: 因度厄，拉开杜恩加尔吧！别让我们失望！

choice:8:0:1.text: We can use your new cannon.
choice:8:0:1.male: We can use your new cannon.
choice:8:0:1.female: We can use your new cannon.

say:33:1410841010:0.text: It's not Indris' bow! That's the divine bow of the dwarves, the Eclipsion!
say:33:1410841010:0.source_cn: 什么因度厄的弓？那是我们矮人的神弓——杜恩加尔！

say:34:1410841011:0.text: He's just—borrowing it, okay?! Only the arrows are his!
say:34:1410841011:0.source_cn: 呃……暂时借出去的！箭矢倒是可以算因度厄的！

say:35:1410841012:0.text: Yes, the Eclipsion and my arrows...
say:35:1410841012:0.source_cn: 嗯，杜恩加尔和我的箭矢。
say:35:1410841012:0.male: Yes, the Eclipsion and my arrows...
say:35:1410841012:0.female: Yes, the Eclipsion and my arrows...

say:37:1410841014:0.text: It'd be bad if the dragon turned us into barbecue skewers.
say:37:1410841014:0.source_cn: 要是被龙喷成风干肉可就完蛋啦！

say:0:1410843001:0.text: I must find Indris and Zanie. This place is full of danger!
say:0:1410843001:0.source_cn: 先找到因度厄和祖娅，这里随时会有危险！
say:0:1410843001:0.male: I must find Indris and Zanie. This place is full of danger!
say:0:1410843001:0.female: I must find Indris and Zanie. This place is full of danger!

say:1:1410844001:1.text: Despite being mentally prepared, the power of the Primordial Dragon was far beyond my imagination.
say:1:1410844001:1.source_cn: 尽管做好了心理准备，但是初始之龙的威力远远超乎我的想象。
say:1:1410844001:1.male: Despite being mentally prepared, the power of the Primordial Dragon was far beyond my imagination.
say:1:1410844001:1.female: Despite being mentally prepared, the power of the Primordial Dragon was far beyond my imagination.

say:5:1410844006:1.text: Did you see where Zanie went?
say:5:1410844006:1.male: Did you see where Zanie went?
say:5:1410844006:1.female: Did you see where Zanie went?

say:6:1410844007:1.text: When we were falling, I heard her scream.
say:6:1410844007:1.source_cn: 掉落的一瞬间，我似乎听见了她的惨叫声。
say:6:1410844007:1.male: When we were falling, I heard her scream.
say:6:1410844007:1.female: When we were falling, I heard her scream.

choice_prompt:7:1410844007.text: When we were falling, I heard her scream.
choice_prompt:7:1410844007.source_cn: 掉落的一瞬间，我似乎听见了她的惨叫声。
choice_prompt:7:1410844007.male: When we were falling, I heard her scream.
choice_prompt:7:1410844007.female: When we were falling, I heard her scream.

say:8:1410844008:0.text: We all fell from the same place, but she could've been blown away by the dragon.
say:8:1410844008:0.source_cn: 我们是从同一个地方掉落的，她可能被龙腾空时刮起的风吹到...
say:8:1410844008:0.male: We all fell from the same place, but she could've been blown away by the dragon.
say:8:1410844008:0.female: We all fell from the same place, but she could've been blown away by the dragon.

narration:10:1410844009:0.text: You try to contact Zanie through her communicator, but there's no response. Your heart races—what if something's wrong? Is she going to be okay?
narration:10:1410844009:0.source_cn: 试着用通讯器联系祖娅，一直无人回应……祖娅不会出事了吧？
narration:10:1410844009:0.male: You try to contact Zanie through her communicator, but there's no response. Your heart races—what if something's wrong? Is she going to be okay?
narration:10:1410844009:0.female: You try to contact Zanie through her communicator, but there's no response. Your heart races—what if something's wrong? Is she going to be okay?

say:11:1410844010:0.text: With your magic as a buffer, I'm sure she's not seriously injured.
say:11:1410844010:0.source_cn: 有你的魔法做缓冲，她应该不会受重伤。
say:11:1410844010:0.male: With your magic as a buffer, I'm sure she's not seriously injured.
say:11:1410844010:0.female: With your magic as a buffer, I'm sure she's not seriously injured.

say:12:1410844011:0.text: Let's look for her while we go after the Primordial Dragon. I'm afraid the dragon's wrath will be unleashed on Sal'thorin.
say:12:1410844011:0.source_cn: 我们边追初始之龙边找她吧，我担心……龙的怒火会烧到萨洛克兰。
say:12:1410844011:0.male: Let's look for her while we go after the Primordial Dragon. I'm afraid the dragon's wrath will be unleashed on Sal'thorin.
say:12:1410844011:0.female: Let's look for her while we go after the Primordial Dragon. I'm afraid the dragon's wrath will be unleashed on Sal'thorin.

say:14:1410844004:1.text: It's still with me and in perfect condition.
say:14:1410844004:1.male: It's still with me and in perfect condition.
say:14:1410844004:1.female: It's still with me and in perfect condition.

say:15:1410844005:1.text: Thank you for your magic. The bow is safe as well.
say:15:1410844005:1.source_cn: 多谢你的魔法。神弓也安然无恙。
say:15:1410844005:1.male: Thank you for your magic. The bow is safe as well.
say:15:1410844005:1.female: Thank you for your magic. The bow is safe as well.

say:1:1410848001:0.text: Ah, the bridge's collapsed! I can't get across! Are you two alright?
say:1:1410848001:0.source_cn: 糟了，桥塌了！我现在过不去，你们两个没事吧？

say:2:1410848002:0.source_cn: 我们没事！倒是你，还好吗？

say:3:1410848003:0.text: Don't worry. This looks like an old dwarven camp; I recognize the structure.
say:3:1410848003:0.source_cn: 放心吧，这看起来是矮人的旧日营地！我清楚营地的构造，问...

choice_prompt:4:1410848003.text: Don't worry. This looks like an old dwarven camp; I recognize the structure.
choice_prompt:4:1410848003.source_cn: 放心吧，再怎么说这也是我们矮人的旧营地，我熟得很！

say:5:1410848004:0.text: I can't. The road over here has been sealed off.
say:5:1410848004:0.source_cn: 不行，这边的路塌的塌，堵的堵。高台倒是好的，但我跳不过去。

say:6:1410848006:1.text: You know what? I'll find my way and meet up with you later. You focus on chasing the dragon. We can use the communicator to contact each other.
say:6:1410848006:1.source_cn: 我去找路，想办法与你们汇合，你们照着龙飞走的方向先去追...

say:8:1410848005:1.text: You can't use the road. You have to find another way around.
say:8:1410848005:1.source_cn: 这边的路走不通，你得想法子绕别的路。

say:0:1410848101:0.text: Can't go further. We'll have to wait for Zanie to catch up.
say:0:1410848101:0.source_cn: 过不去了，只能先追上龙，等祖娅找我们汇合了。
say:0:1410848101:0.male: Can't go further. We'll have to wait for Zanie to catch up.
say:0:1410848101:0.female: Can't go further. We'll have to wait for Zanie to catch up.

say:1:1410856001:2.text: Vile snake! That treacherous backstabber! <shk>Where is Helthor</shk>, the so-called god who brought disgrace upon me?!
say:1:1410856001:2.source_cn: 可憎的家伙！那个暗算者，令吾之身躯蒙尘的所谓神明，<s...

choice_prompt:2:1410856001.text: Vile snake! That treacherous backstabber! <shk>Where is Helthor</shk>, the so-called god who brought disgrace upon me?!
choice_prompt:2:1410856001.source_cn: 可憎的家伙！那个暗算者，令吾之身躯蒙尘的所谓神明，<shk>赫托在哪里！！！</shk>

say:5:1410856003:0.text: That's right! Helthor has been dead for thousands of years!
say:5:1410856003:0.source_cn: 没错！数千年前，赫托老爹就已经不在了！

say:7:1410856004:2.text: *Cackle* Wonderful! A fate most fitting for a traitor!
say:7:1410856004:2.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈！好极了！好极了！这就是背叛者应得的命运！

say:8:1410856005:0.text: It has been eons since I last unfurled my wings. Was it you scaleless mortals who unbound me?
say:8:1410856005:0.source_cn: 多少年了……吾之身躯终于得以舒展。是汝等手持肮脏武器的...

say:9:1410856006:0.text: Know this, whatever the reason for awakening me from that humiliating slumber, I grant you the privilege of knowing my name!
say:9:1410856006:0.source_cn: 无论出于怎样的理由，看在汝等将吾从那屈辱梦境中唤醒的份...

say:10:1410856007:0.text: I am the flame of the abyss, the heart of the crystal, the third daughter of the earth and sky, and a sister to the stars.
say:10:1410856007:0.source_cn: 吾乃渊底之火，岩晶之心，天空与大地的第三女，众星之姊妹——

say:13:1410856009:0.text: Just like what historical records said... The Primordial Dragon came to Esperia from the sea of stars and formed a friendship with Helthor ten millennia ago...
say:13:1410856009:0.source_cn: 和记载里一模一样啊……从星海来到伊索米亚的初始之龙，在...

say:24:1410858019:3.text: Then I shall wait for you to fulfill the oath you've sworn.
say:24:1410858019:3.source_cn: 那么，吾就在此处等待汝等兑现承诺吧。

narration:27:1410858021:2.text: Azkarion'Sol unfurls her mighty wings, and you're hurled into the distance with a powerful gust.
narration:27:1410858021:2.source_cn: 巨龙阿兹卡·夏挥动翅膀，你们一行人被卷起飞到了远处。

choice:18:1:2.text: What did they do to Esperia?
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 祂对伊索米亚做了什么？
choice:18:1:2.male: What did they do to Esperia?
choice:18:1:2.female: What did they do to Esperia?

choice:4:0:1.text: Why do you call me that?
choice:4:0:1.male: Why do you call me that?
choice:4:0:1.female: Why do you call me that?

say:0:1410859001:0.text: That stings slightly more than traveling by a teleportation circle!
say:0:1410859001:0.source_cn: 被龙拍走的感觉比晕传送阵强一点……就一点！

say:1:1410859002:0.text: Let's go to the palace and settle things with the Queen.
say:1:1410859002:0.source_cn: ……事不宜迟，去宫殿里和奈萨雷斯做个了断吧。

say:4:1410807201:1.text: Ravion, the guards have been acting up. Why can't you restrain your men?!
say:4:1410807201:1.source_cn: 沙利叶，现在卫队一团乱，你能不能好好约束自己的队伍！

say:5:1410807202:1.text: Don't look at me. It's your fault we're in this state.
say:5:1410807202:1.source_cn: 哦，那又如何？说来也都是你们的错……

say:7:1410807204:1.text: You're the ones that locked up Indris. Of course the guards are a mess.
say:7:1410807204:1.source_cn: 谁让你们把因度厄关了起来，他不管，卫队可不就瘫痪了。

say:8:1410807205:1.text: You're the Imperator, the commander of the guards!

say:9:1410807206:1.text: As the Imperator, I don't truly know how things run. It's my subordinates who handle the real work. Now that you're aware of this, leave the guards to their duties.
say:9:1410807206:1.source_cn: 管理者不需要自己过问，手下才是真正干活的人。你既然知道...

say:11:1410807207:1.text: I don't know what those unruly commoners will do once order starts to crumble. To keep things from falling apart, you'd better release Indris sooner rather than later.
say:11:1410807207:1.source_cn: 我可不知道一旦缺乏管教，那些易怒的平民又会做出什么事来...

say:12:1410807208:1.text: That's impossible. He knows too much, and he has already disobeyed Her Majesty.
say:12:1410807208:1.source_cn: 不可能，他已经知道了太多，又违逆了女王陛下。

say:13:1410807209:1.text: Yes, of course. He was never going to end up like you—my mother's loyal hound.
say:13:1410807209:1.source_cn: 是是是，他当然不能跟你一样，最后沦为我母亲的狗。

say:15:1410807211:0.text: Oh, by the way, Velara said she wanted to see you. She's at the Wisteria Hall.
say:15:1410807211:0.source_cn: 哦，对了，奎茵说有事找你，紫藤会见厅。

narration:21:14010817:0.text: Reaching the palace gate precisely as planned, you observe Lord Ravion in conversation with Thador. Zanie quietly motions for you to conceal yourself, bidding you wait until Thador departs.
narration:21:14010817:0.source_cn: 你准时抵达了王宫门前，却看到了沙利叶和都铎正在交谈。祖...
narration:21:14010817:0.male: Reaching the palace gate precisely as planned, you observe Lord Ravion in conversation with Thador. Zanie quietly motions for you to conceal yourself, bidding you wait until Thador departs.
narration:21:14010817:0.female: Reaching the palace gate precisely as planned, you observe Lord Ravion in conversation with Thador. Zanie quietly motions for you to conceal yourself, bidding you wait until Thador departs.

narration:22:14010817:0.text: Reaching the palace gate precisely as planned, you observe Lord Ravion in conversation with Thador. Zanie quietly motions for you to conceal yourself, bidding you wait until Thador departs.
narration:22:14010817:0.source_cn: 你准时抵达了王宫门前，却看到了沙利叶和都铎正在交谈。祖...
narration:22:14010817:0.male: Reaching the palace gate precisely as planned, you observe Lord Ravion in conversation with Thador. Zanie quietly motions for you to conceal yourself, bidding you wait until Thador departs.
narration:22:14010817:0.female: Reaching the palace gate precisely as planned, you observe Lord Ravion in conversation with Thador. Zanie quietly motions for you to conceal yourself, bidding you wait until Thador departs.

say:4:1410820201:0.text: Velara, we can't let them get away.

say:5:1410820202:1.text: I understand your concerns, Lord Thador. All will be well.
say:5:1410820202:1.source_cn: 我理解您的担忧，都铎大人。

say:6:1410820203:1.text: Indris has rejected the Divine Dew. Without its nourishment, he will soon be corrupted.
say:6:1410820203:1.source_cn: 因度厄已经拒绝了灵露。没有恩典的滋养，他很快就会孽化。

say:7:1410820204:1.text: At that point, his companions will either finish him off or watch him turn into a monster.
say:7:1410820204:1.source_cn: 到那时候，他的同伴要么亲手了结他，要么看着他变成怪物。

say:8:1410820205:1.text: Isn't this better than executing him?
say:8:1410820205:1.source_cn: 这比杀了他更好，不是吗？

say:10:1410820207:1.text: Should he choose to reconsider his path, he shall return to us and partake of the Divine Dew... A far more preferable turn of events, wouldn't you agree?
say:10:1410820207:1.source_cn: 万一他回心转意，喝下恩典灵露……那就更好了。

say:11:1410820208:1.text: He will come to see the wisdom and benevolence of Her Majesty's intentions.
say:11:1410820208:1.source_cn: 他就会明白女王大人的良苦用心。

say:14:1410820211:0.text: ...Understood. I'll order our soldiers to stop the pursuit then...
say:14:1410820211:0.source_cn: 我明白了。众士兵听令，停止追击——

narration:15:1410820212:0.text: In the meantime, you, Zanie, and Indris successfully teleport to the Temple of Helthor...
narration:15:1410820212:0.source_cn: 与此同时，你、祖娅和因度厄也成功传送到赫托神殿……
narration:15:1410820212:0.male: In the meantime, you, Zanie, and Indris successfully teleport to the Temple of Helthor...
narration:15:1410820212:0.female: In the meantime, you, Zanie, and Indris successfully teleport to the Temple of Helthor...

narration:17:140108119:0.text: You all teleport out of the palace just in time. Thador tries to give chase but is stopped by Velara.
narration:17:140108119:0.source_cn: 你们紧急传送离开了宫殿，都铎试图继续追击时，被奎茵拦了下来。
narration:17:140108119:0.male: You all teleport out of the palace just in time. Thador tries to give chase but is stopped by Velara.
narration:17:140108119:0.female: You all teleport out of the palace just in time. Thador tries to give chase but is stopped by Velara.

say:5:1410822002:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the Sylvan Tendril helped you stop Indris' transformation!
say:5:1410822002:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the Sylvan Tendril helped you stop Indris' transformation!
say:5:1410822002:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the Sylvan Tendril helped you stop Indris' transformation!

say:6:1410822003:1.text: You should use your purification magic on him now!
say:6:1410822003:1.source_cn: 趁现在，对因度厄使用你最拿手的净化魔法！
say:6:1410822003:1.male: You should use your purification magic on him now!
say:6:1410822003:1.female: You should use your purification magic on him now!

narration:11:14010822:0.text: Indris nears the brink of corruption, his resolve hardening as he rejects the Divine Dew. As his body contorts in pain, the Sylvan Tendril swoops in and soothes his torment.
narration:11:14010822:0.source_cn: 因度厄似乎快要孽化了，但他拒绝再喝灵露了。此时，织叶飞...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410810002:.text: We need men in the west region.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410810004:.text: Is the queen's safety not important?!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410810004:.source_cn: 女王的安危不是更重要？

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410818001:.text: Time to make a run for it!

subtitle:1:1410834101:.text: I know the consequences and understand the risks.
subtitle:1:1410834101:.source_cn: 我知道后果，也明白风险

subtitle:1:1410834102:.text: Let truth be the light that shatters the dark!
subtitle:1:1410834102:.source_cn: 唯有真相，才能照亮黑暗！

subtitle:1:1411089001:.source_cn: 卑鄙的矮人！无耻的窃贼！

subtitle:1:1411089002:.text: Your insatiable greed shall be cleansed in fire!
subtitle:1:1411089002:.source_cn: 汝之贪婪将以烈焰偿还！

subtitle:1:1411091005:.text: I have no need for your false protection!
subtitle:1:1411091005:.source_cn: 吾不需要这虚伪的保护！

subtitle:1:1411092005:.text: Helthor never bestowed his grace upon you!
subtitle:1:1411092005:.source_cn: 因度厄！赫托没有给你恩赐——

subtitle:1:1411092010:.text: You have what you came for. Now leave at once.
subtitle:1:1411092010:.source_cn: 尔等已得所求，即刻离去
